title: OCT New England - 2026

## Meet us in Boston for the 18th Annual Outsourcing in Clinical Trials New England


Clinical development is becoming more complex, but bringing innovative therapies to patients shouldn't be. Fortrea's experts will be on hand at OCT New England 2026, to discuss strategies for optimizing trial execution, enhancing operational efficiency, and advancing programs across the development lifecycle.


Stop by Booth #4 to connect with our team and learn how we're helping sponsors navigate today's challenges and tomorrow's opportunities.


#### Presentation

**Date:** Oct. 27
